name: Package scanner
description: Scans dependency versions per release line in Azure DevOps or GitHub repositories (NuGet, npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, Composer, RubyGems, Cargo), the newest versions and OSV advisories.

credential_code.label: Team credential with the personal access token (type Secret)

max_major.label: Highest release major (blank means no limit)

latest_packages.label: Packages to check for the newest version (blank means all direct dependencies)
